strings.subtitle: — Lekhana vināso —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ākaḍḍhanaṃ vissajjanañ ca na labbhati. Upari-piṇḍakaṃ gaṇha.
strings.shred_button: V I N Ā S E H I
strings.ssd_warning:
Aṭṭhikaṃ! SSD-smiṃ, TRIM-kāraṇena, upari-lekhanavidhi vināsaṃ na paṭijānāti.
Idaṃ vidhānaṃ HDD-āya hoti.
strings.confirm_text:
Lekhanaṃ "{name}" upari likhissati vināsayissati ca.

Anugacchasi?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  LEKHANAṂ UPARI LIKHITAÑ CA VINĀSITAÑ CA
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS aññā dhātudhārā (ADS) na kariyyanti.
• USN-potthakaṃ na sodhiyati.
• Chāyā-pratiyā ca megha-samavāyā
  (OneDrive ādayo) na phusiyanti.
strings.status_full: Antaṭṭhaṃ sabbaṃ suññehi upari likhitaṃ. Paccāharaṇaṃ asambhavaṃ — yantāni suññāni yeva dakkhanti.
strings.status_fast: Sīsaṃ, pucchañ ca 4 MB paṭiyo upari likhitā. Sesam aphuṭṭhaṃ, api ca chiddānaṃ kāraṇena yantehi paripuṇṇaṃ paccāharaṇaṃ asambhavaṃ. Rahassa-lekhanānaṃ PUṆṆA-vidhiṃ gaṇha.
strings.status_empty: Lekhanaṃ suññaṃ ahosi, upari lekhaṃ na icchitaṃ. Vināsitaṃ.
strings.error_permission: Lekhanaṃ pavisituṃ na sakkomi. Aññasmiṃ vidhāne vivaṭaṃ siyā. Pidhāya puna yatāhi.
strings.error_not_found: Lekhanaṃ na laddhaṃ. Pubbam eva vināsitaṃ siyā.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ayaṃ saṅketa-yogo. Yogā vināsituṃ na sakkonti — lakkhaṇa-lekhanaṃ sakalaṃ tiṭṭhati.
strings.error_reparse: Ayaṃ ṭhāna-lekhanaṃ (OneDrive athavā tādisaṃ). Tassa dhātavo meghasmiṃ santī, na cakke — idha vināsituṃ natthi kiñci.
strings.error_not_file: Idaṃ lekhanaṃ na hoti (koṭṭhaṃ aññaṃ vā). Lekhanaṃ vissajjehi.
strings.error_hardlinks: Imassa lekhanassa aññe daḷha-yogā santi ({n} sabbe). Daḷha-yogānaṃ pāmokkho natthi — sabbāni nāmāni samāni. Sace paccuppanna-maggena vināsayissasi, dhātavo upari likhiyissanti yāva 32 byte chijjissanti ca, api ca avasesaṃ aññehi yogehi adhigantuṃ sakkā. Paṭhamaṃ sabbe yoge vināsehi.
strings.error_compressed:
Lekhanaṃ saṅkhittaṃ, gūḷhaṃ vā tanukaṃ vā. Suññehi upari-lekhaṃ purātana-dhātūnaṃ vināsaṃ na paṭijānāti, yasmā NTFS aññathā tā rakkhati.

Guṇaṃ nīhara: dakkhiṇa-klikkaṃ → Guṇā → Paguṇaṃ → nīhara saññaṃ "Saṅkhara" athavā "Gūḷha". Tato puna SEDDARO-yaṃ cārehi.
